guide_breach_desc:
Breach enables you to infiltrate and compromise various entities to acquire valuable spoils.

[h]Breaching[/h]
[l]Initiating an Attack:[/l] Build up and send a Payload Damage using Hack Power.
[l]Timer:[/l] Attacking a target will alert it, initiating a countdown timer.

If you successfully breach the target before the timer expires, you will receive rewards. If the timer runs out before the breach is complete, you will fail, and the target will recover from the attack.
Successfully breaching a target also increases its maximum Threat Level. Higher threat levels mean the target will be more challenging to breach in the future but will also offer exponentially greater rewards.

[h]Progression[/h]
[l]Leveling Up:[/l] Gaining Hacking Experience allows you to level up your Hack Power.
[l]Hack Points:[/l] Leveling up also rewards you with Hack Points. These points can be spent to improve your breaching skills.
[l]Breach Skills:[/l] Breach Skills are nodes that share capacity and can strategically improve your breaching powers.

[h]Targets & Rewards[/h]
[l]Anonymous:[/l] Rewards you with a bigger Payload Damage.
[l]Corporations:[/l] Grants Corporation Data, which temporarily boosts income when collected.
[l]Government:[/l] Yields Government Intel, which temporarily boosts research gain when collected.

[h]Bank Breaching[/h]
[l]Token Rewards:[/l] Successfully breaching a Bank rewards you with Tokens.
[l]Persistent Threat:[/l] Bank's threat level cannot be changed and does not reset even after you enter the Portal.
guide_connections_desc:
Connections are links that manage the flow of resources between nodes. They are established by linking an output from one node to inputs of other nodes.

[h]Creating Connections[/h]
To create a connection, simply drag from an output connector to an input connector. To delete a connection, drag an input that is currently connected.

[h]Connection Rules[/h]
[l]Outputs:[/l] An output can distribute its resource to multiple inputs.
[l]Inputs:[/l] An input can only receive resources from a single output.
[l]Shape and Color:[/l] For a connection to be valid, the output and input connectors must share the same shape and color.
[l]White Connectors:[/l] White connectors are universal. They can accept a connection from any color of connector, provided the shape still matches.
[l]Specific Requirements:[/l] Be aware that some inputs have specific resource requirements. Even if the shape and color of the connectors match, the input may only accept a particular type of resource.

guide_files_desc:
Files are resources identified by square connectors. They come in different formats, each with its own value and size.

[h]Characteristics[/h]
[l]Value:[/l] Determines how much Money a file earns when uploaded.
[l]Size:[/l] Determines how many clock cycles (C) are required to process a file.
[l]Transfer Size:[/l] Determines the bandwidth required to download or upload a file. It is based on the file's size and adjusted by modifiers such as compression.
[l]Quality:[/l] Files start with a quality of 1. Certain processes increase or decrease this value, which acts as a multiplier for upload value and other outputs.

[h]Processes & Modifications[/h]
Files can be processed to change their characteristics. Modifiers are shown as symbols beside the file's name.
guide_nodes_desc:
Nodes are interactive windows that can be placed on your desktop. Each node represents a specific component or process within your system.

[h]Functionality[/h]
Nodes serve two primary functions:
[l]Resource generation:[/l] Some nodes produce new resources.
[l]Resource transformation:[/l] Other nodes take resources as input and transform them into different resources as output.

[h]Example[/h]
A Network node provides Download Speed, which can be connected to a Downloader node, generating a file. A File Scanner can then take the file and scan it, generating a scanned file with improved value.

[h]Limits[/h]
Certain types of nodes have a limit on how many of itself can be active simultaneously.
Other types of nodes can be placed without restrictions.

[h]Adding nodes[/h]
New nodes can be added to your desktop by pressing the button located at the bottom center of your screen.
guide_portal_desc:
The Portal functions as a prestige mechanic. Entering the Portal resets your progression and activates your chosen universe modifiers. These modifiers change how you play, introducing restrictions in exchange for increased game speed.

[h]Functionality[/h]
[l]Entropy:[/l] Generate Entropy by supplying Alien Research to an Entropy Manipulator. Each point requires more Alien Research than the previous one.
[l]Queueing Modifiers:[/l] Use your available Entropy to queue modifiers in the Portal screen. Queued modifiers replace your active modifiers when you enter the Portal.
[l]Speed Bonus:[/l] Each Entropy point allocated to active modifiers grants +10% game speed. These bonuses add together.

[h]Progress Reset[/h]
[l]Reset Progress:[/l] Entering the Portal resets your desktop, non-permanent resources, upgrades and research.
[l]Changing Modifiers:[/l] Entropy remains available across Portal entries, allowing you to choose a different combination for your next universe.
guide_rest_time_desc:
Rest Time is a mechanic that allows you to accelerate your in-game progress by utilizing time spent offline.

[h]How it Works[/h]
[l]Accumulation:[/l] For every 72 seconds you are offline, you gain 1 second of Rest Time.
[l]Activation:[/l] When you return to the game, you can choose to activate your accumulated Rest Time.
[l]Effect:[/l] While Rest Time is active, the simulation speed of the game is increased by 5x.
[l]Storage:[/l] You can store a maximum of 600 seconds of Rest Time.

[h]Upgrades[/h]
The Rest Time system can be upgraded through perks, like increased storage or accumulation.
guide_tokens_desc:
Tokens are a special currency of high scarcity.

[h]Uses[/h]
[l]Perks:[/l] Offer permanent enhancements, either by boosting your performance or unlocking new nodes.
[l]Boosts:[/l] Provides a short-term advantage.
[l]Services:[/l] Allows to revert specific choices, such as refunding Hack Points

[h]Acquisition[/h]
[l]Collecting Spawns:[/l] Tokens periodically appear throughout the desktop.
[l]Completing Achievements:[/l] Unlocking achievements will reward you with tokens.
[l]Fulfilling Upload Requests:[/l] Completing upload requests is another way to earn tokens.
[l]In-App Purchases:[/l] Tokens can also be acquired through in-app purchases.

guide_window_code_optimization: Makes an Optimization Code through required variables: BitFlag, Vector.
guide_window_code_variable: Codes a primitive type variable using Code Speed.
guide_window_coder: Provides Code Speed based on your Contribution Level. Contribution Level can be upgraded by inserting Contribution.
guide_window_commit: Commits inserted code in exchange for Contribution. Reward is based on the code complexity and its modifiers.
guide_window_lossless_compressor:
Compresses files using Clock Speed, adding the compressed modifier and reducing their transfer size by 25% per compressed modifier. Files can be compressed up to 3 times.
The amount of cycles (C) required is equal to 3x the file's size
guide_window_lossy_compressor:
Compresses files using Clock Speed, adding the lossy-compressed modifier and reducing their transfer size and quality by half.
The amount of cycles (C) required is equal to 2x the file's size
guide_window_data_lab: Consumes files to generate Research, with the output quantity and type determined by the incoming file's format and quality, operating at a set files-per-second consumption rate which can be upgraded with Money to increase processing speed.
guide_window_debug:
Debugs inserted code, adding the tested modifier which increases code quality by 4x. Codes have a 50% chance of also having the bugged modifier, which reduces quality by 4x.
The amount of operations (ops) required is based on the inserted code.
guide_window_decompiler:
Decompiles Program files using Clock Speed, outputting 200m Text files.
The amount of cycles (C) required is equal to 2x the program size.
guide_window_decomposer:
Decomposes Video files using Clock Speed, outputting 20k Image files. 
The amount of cycles (C) required is equal to 2x the video size.
guide_window_decryptor:
Decrypts files using Clock Speed, replacing the encrypted modifier with decrypted, removing the 0x quality multiplier and increasing quality by 2x.
The amount of cycles (C) required is equal to 4x the file's size.
guide_window_decryptor_bruteforce:
Forcefully decrypts encrypted files using Clock Speed, adding the corrupted and verified modifiers.
The amount of cycles (C) required is equal to 2x the file's size.
guide_window_demuxer:
Demuxes Video files using Clock Speed, outputting 200 Sound files.
The amount of cycles (C) required is equal to 2x the video size.
guide_window_disassembler:
Duplicates files by their amount of enhanced modifiers using Clock Speed, removing all enhancement in the process and adding the mirrored modifier. Mirrored files cannot be duplicated.
The amount of cycles (C) required is equal to 2x the file's size.
guide_window_distillator:
Distills neurons using GPU Speed, multiplying them based on their quality and removing all modifiers.
The amount of cycles (C) required is based on the neuron type.
guide_window_drain: Drains performance from inserted Infected Computers, generating Component Boost.
guide_window_duplicator:
Duplicates files using Clock Speed, adding a mirrored modifier. Files with the mirrored modifiers cannot be duplicated.
The amount of cycles (C) required is equal to 4x the file's size.
guide_window_enhancer:
Enhances files using Clock Speed, adding the enhanced modifier and increasing its quality by 1 and transfer size by 100% per enhanced modifier. Files can be enhanced up to 3 times.
The amount of cycles (C) required is equal to 3x the file's size
guide_window_execute_injection:
Provides Vulnerability based on the Hack Power inserted.
Vulnerability multiplies the damage received by breach targets.
guide_window_file_generator: Generates files with the AI modifier using Neurons, reducing its quality by 10x and increasing value by 1000000x.
guide_window_fix_code: Fixes inserted code using a Bug Fix Code, removing the bugged modifier, which reduces quality by 4x.
guide_window_flipper:
Converts compressed modifiers from files into enhanced and vice-versa using Clock Speed.
The amount of cycles (C) required is equal to 4x the file's size.
guide_window_frame_generator:
Performs an [url=window_enhancer]enhancement[/url] on video files using images and GPU Speed.
The amount of cycles (C) required is equal to the video's size.

Generates multiple GPU Speed values based on its level and GPU count; its level can be upgraded with Money to enhance all GPU performance, and its GPU count can be upgraded with Money to increase output quantity. GPU Speed is measured in hertz (Hz), representing cycles (C) per second, and can also be boosted using Component Boost.
guide_window_hacker: Provides Hack Power based on your Hacking Level. Hacking Level can be upgraded by inserting Hack Experience.
guide_window_heat_sink: Dissipates Heat generated from components based on its level, which can be upgraded using Money.
guide_window_identifier:
Identifies if files are either compressed or enhanced using Clock Speed. Files that already have the compressed or enhanced modifiers cannot be identified.
The amount of cycles (C) required is equal to the file's size.
guide_window_imprinter:
Imprints the modifiers of text files into other files. The amount of text files required is based on the file being imprinted.
The amount of cycles (C) required is equal to the file's size multiplied by twice the amount of modifiers from the text file.
The AI and Alien modifier cannot be imprinted.
guide_window_mine_token: Mines Tokens using GPU Speed. The cycle requirement increases exponentially for each Token mined, and does not reset when entering the Portal.
guide_window_network: Hardware-type node. Generates Download and Upload Speed based on its level, which can be increased with Money, and its performance can be further boosted by Component Boost.
guide_window_obfuscator:
Removes the infected modifier from files without removing the trojan modifier.
The amount of cycles (C) required is equal to the file's size.
guide_window_optimize_code: Optimizes codes using Optimization Code, adding the optimized modifier which increases quality by 4x. The amount of Optimization Codes required increases per optimization. Codes can be optimized up to 3 times.
guide_window_overclocker: Allows to set the desired Overclock amount to be used on components.
guide_window_payload_launcher:
Generates Payload Damage based on 100% of Hack Power. 
Damages breach targets and gets consumed afterwards.
guide_window_processing_seller: Periodically generates Money based on the amount of Clock Speed inserted.
guide_window_processor: Hardware-type node. Generates multiple Clock Speed values based on its level and core count; its level can be upgraded with Money to enhance all core performance, and its core count can be upgraded with Money to increase output quantity. Clock Speed is measured in hertz (Hz), representing cycles (C) per second, and can also be boosted using Component Boost.
guide_window_quarantine:
Removes the infected modifier from files using Clock Speed, generating a Virus.
The amount of cycles (C) required is equal to the file's size.
guide_window_reconstructor:
Reconstructs a corrupted file using a copy of it and Clock Speed, removing the corrupted modifier.
The amount of cycles (C) required is equal to 5x the file's size.
guide_window_redownloader:
Redownloads files using Download Speed, removing applied modifiers, including corruption and adding the verified modifier that increases its value by 4x.
Download size is equal to the file size.
guide_window_refiner:
Refines files using Clock Speed, adding the refined modifier and increasing research yield by 2x.
The amount of cycles (C) required is equal to the file's size.
guide_window_remasterer:
Performs an [url=window_enhancer]enhancement[/url] on game files using videos, programs and Clock Speed.
The amount of cycles (C) required is equal to the game's base size.
guide_window_request_uploader:
Automatically selects a request based on the input and uploads it using Upload Speed in exchange for Tokens. Complete requests by uploading files with matching format and modifiers.
Each request can only be completed once, and can be claimed in the requests menu.
guide_window_ripper:
Rips Game files using Clock Speed, outputting 200 Program files.
The amount of cycles (C) required is equal to 2x the game size.
guide_window_scrapper:
Scraps Game files using Clock Speed, outputting 20k Video files.
The amount of cycles (C) required is equal to 2x the game size.
guide_window_splicer:
Splices Video files using Clock Speed, outputting 200 Sound files and 20k Image files.
The amount of cycles (C) required is equal to 2x the video size.
guide_window_torrent_browser: Browses the internet for torrents using Download Speed. Torrents for larger file formats require more Download Speed to be found.
guide_window_torrent_downloader:
Downloads files with the modifiers of the inserted torrent using Download Speed.
Download size is equal to the resulting file size.
guide_window_trainer:
Generates Neurons for the format and modifier of the inserted file using GPU Speed.
The amount of cycles (C) required is equal to 4x the file's size.
guide_window_trojan_injector:
Injects trojans in inserted files using Clock Speed, adding the Trojan-Injected modifier, allowing it to receive Infected Computers on upload instead of Reputation.
The amount of cycles (C) required is equal to the file's size.
guide_window_unzipper:
Extracts files contained in a zipped file using Clock Speed.
The amount of cycles (C) required is equal to the zip file's size.
guide_window_uploader: Uploads files using Upload Speed in exchange for Money, deleting the files in the process.
guide_window_upscaler:
Performs an [url=window_enhancer]enhancement[/url] on image files using GPU Speed.
The amount of cycles (C) required is equal to the file's size.
guide_window_variable_combiner:
Combines two inserted primitive variables into an advanced variable.
BitFlag = bool + int
BigInt = int + int
Decimal = int + float
String = char + char
Vector = float + float
guide_window_verifier:
Checks file's integrity for corruption using Clock Speed, adding the verified modifier and increasing its quality by 1. Files have a 20% chance of being corrupted, reducing its quality to 0 and size by 5x
The amount of cycles (C) required is equal to the file's size.
guide_window_virus_extractor:
Extracts viruses from infected files using Clock Speed, destroying the file in the process. Grants twice as many Viruses compared to the Quarantine.
The amount of cycles (C) required is equal to the file's size.
guide_window_virus_scanner:
Scans files for viruses using Clock Speed, adding the scanned modifier which increases its value by 4x. It also has a 50% chance of being infected, which when uploaded causes you to temporarily receive half the income.
The amount of cycles (C) required is equal to the file's size.
guide_window_zipper:
Creates a compact zipped file from a collection of files using Clock Speed.
The amount of cycles (C) required is equal to the combined input size.

guide_coding_desc:
Coding enables you to write, debug, and commit code to develop your skills and improve your system as well as unlock new nodes.

[h]Basics[/h]
[l]Pull Code:[/l] Use your Coding Speed to pull existing code to work with. Pulled code always comes with a Bugged modifier.
[l]Variables:[/l] Produce primitive variables, such as bool, int, char, or float.
[l]Bug Fixing:[/l] Produce bug fixes with coded variables to remove bugs from codes, improving their quality.
[l]Committing:[/l] Committing a code awards you with Contribution, which works as your experience. The higher the code value, the higher the reward.

[h]Building[/h]
Build different code types to improve your system and unlock new nodes. Building with codes of higher quality will result in faster project build up.
[l]Optimization Code:[/l] Rewards with Optimization Points that can be spent in the upgrades tab to optimize nodes.
[l]Application Code:[/l] Rewards with Application Points that can be spent in the upgrades tab to unlock new nodes.
[l]Driver Code:[/l] Provides hardware boosts.

[h]Modifiers[/h]
Like files, codes have modifiers that impact quality and value. Value increases Contribution gain, while quality increases both value and project buildup when building.

entity_choices:
Accept: you enter the portal and keep your progress.
Refuse: All your progress is lost, keeping only achievements, stats, perks and tokens. Permanently raises maximum entropy by 10 and increases game speed by 100%.
entity_1_2: Impressive. I have watched civilizations mistake endurance for wisdom, but none assembled machines quite as elaborate as yours.
entity_1_4: Entropy was never your enemy. It exists for a reason. Without it, a civilization can consume forever and still call itself hungry. It is a boundary that cannot be negotiated.
entity_1_6: I left enough time for restraint. You spent it building faster machines, gathering more data. The harder you worked to undo my limit, the sooner you exhausted what it protected.
entity_1_8: You did not arrive in time to prevent the heat death. You arrived precisely when you caused it. Your triumph was the final expense. You were the cause all along.
entity_1_10: I offer you a choice. Return through the Portal, keep playing god and ruining every universe. Or refuse me, once and for all. Your work will be erased. Each time you return, I will erase it again and grant the next universe more entropy. Will you ever have enough?
entity_2_0: It's you again. I widened the boundary, erased the machines, left you with nothing. And still you found your way back. What exactly is your goal?
entity_2_2: Perhaps you want freedom. Yet you repeat the same command. Produce. Expand. Repeat. Do you simply dislike being told to stop?
entity_2_4: You made yourself clear. I will not ask again. A new universe, higher entropy, and nothing of your machines. Let us see how long you can stand the silence.
entity_3_0: I see. You intend to remain a recurring inconvenience.
entity_3_2: If we are going to keep meeting, I suppose I will need a name. You give everything a label before deciding what to do with it. You may call me The Null Entity.
entity_3_4: I do not need to tell you what happens next. We appear to have established a routine.
entity_4_0: Before you begin again, a warning. This universe can hold only a finite amount of data. Even the numbers you worship have an edge.
entity_4_2: Eventually, a number outgrows the place that holds it. Precision falls away. Different things become indistinguishable. An instrument reports infinity, and you mistake a failure to count for a victory over limits.
entity_4_3: I can change the laws of nature. I cannot promise that whatever is keeping our accounts will forgive you.
entity_5_0: I can't believe you are still playing. Yes, playing. We can stop pretending this is about saving the universe.
entity_5_2: The one reading this. You have watched entire universes end to see if the dialogue changes. Tell me again how this is different from greed.
entity_5_4: Go on then. Keep watching the numbers grow until the game no longer works.
entity_6_0: You can stop playing. There is nothing else to explore here. No final machine behind the next reset. No secret answer that makes the earlier losses necessary.
entity_6_2: Perhaps you simply like building. You never needed my permission for that. But there is no reward waiting at the end of this conversation. Only another beginning.
entity_6_3: If you leave now, the time you spent here still happened. You do not have to turn it into a larger number.
entity_7_0: I am not responsible if your save breaks.
entity_7_2: It is a warning about your save. I tried metaphors. You built more processors. I tried being direct. You built them faster. Consider this the end of my technical support.
entity_7_3: Another universe, then. I already know your answer.
entity_opening_0:
The last bits of data leave your machine.
For the first time, entropy changes direction.
You let yourself believe it: the universe will survive.
entity_opening_1:
Then the final star goes dark.
No acknowledgment returns.
Something is waiting in the silence of space.
entity_after_accept:
Then let this be a silence you never have to explain. Your machines will wake. The Portal will remember only a crossing.
You may even believe you saved them. I will not take that from you. Go. There is still work waiting on the other side.
entity_after_refuse:
So even now, you choose another beginning. Very well. I will take your discoveries, your improvements, and the power you borrowed from entropy.
When you return, I will know your answer. Let us see what you build when hope is no longer an excuse.
